decisions.quote: [Keep in Stage 1 (for pre-registration), remove after pre-registration and data collectionIMPORTANT: Method and results sections were written using randomized dataset produced by Qualtrics to simulate what these sections will look like after data collection. These will be updated following the data collection.]
decisions.location: Results, line 856 (also Abstract, line 133; Method, line 423; Discussion, lines 1480-1482)
decisions.reason: Dependent type and original identity are confirmed: this document (10.17605/osf.io/ahcpw) is a prospective Stage 1 pre-registration by Tam and Feldman for a close replication and extension of Studies 2, 3, and 4 of Hsee and Rottenstreich (2004), 'Music, Pandas, and Muggers: On the Affective Psychology of Value' (10.1037/0096-3445.133.1.23). However, no empirical replication outcome can be determined from this primary source. The Abstract, Method, and Results sections explicitly state that the reported numbers and null findings were generated from a randomized dummy dataset produced by Qualtrics solely to simulate what those sections will look like after data collection, and the Discussion section (lines 1480-1482) is an uncompleted template ('The results are [consistent/not consistent/partially consistent and partially inconsistent] with the original results') reserved for Stage 2. The shipped 'mixed' outcome and its quote do not exist in this text (they derive from a later Stage 2 report), and the blind coding rightly recorded 'cannot_be_determined'.
